art_direction: Enclosed industrial kart hall; cyan, violet and pink LED rails; dark glossy asphalt; close barriers and overhead trusses. v0.8.0 is a less sinuous technical layout: chicane, fast corners, two jump crests, a banked climbing carousel, a Nordschleife-style kink section, a right-angle castle section crossing over the track, a corkscrew drop and seven compound downhill hairpins. Corner characters are adapted from real circuits, a mountain road and a classic castle course (see corners and features); geometry, names on site and the route are original.
external_vehicle_system: CHIKUWA VEHICLE SYSTEM 2 (CVS2), installed by the world owner
runtime_status: CVS2 steering, vehicle dimensions, multiplayer, lightmap baking and PC/Quest frame timings require Unity/VRChat validation.
